tracks.name: Well-rounded software engineer
tracks.blurb: Every core phase, in order. The longest route. Pick this if you are not sure what you want to build.

tracks.name: Learn Python properly (no career pressure)
tracks.blurb: The language, engineering habits and problem solving, ending with automation. Leaves out the infrastructure phases.

tracks.name: Backend & API engineer
tracks.blurb: Databases, HTTP services, auth, containers and deployment. The most common Python job.

tracks.name: Data analysis & data engineering
tracks.blurb: SQL first, then pipelines, warehouses and orchestration.

tracks.name: AI & machine learning engineer
tracks.blurb: The math and the infrastructure around models, plus the engineering phases needed to ship one.

tracks.name: Automation, scripting & scraping
tracks.blurb: Scripts that do repetitive work, then making them handle failures.

tracks.name: DevOps & platform engineering
tracks.blurb: Linux, networking, containers, CI/CD and operations.

tracks.name: Application security
tracks.blurb: Build an app first, then learn to attack it and fix it.

tracks.name: Job-ready, fastest route
tracks.blurb: The language, data structures, algorithms, SQL and one tested, deployed service. Aimed at technical interviews.

tracks.name: Desktop apps & developer tools
tracks.blurb: GUI applications and command-line tools that people install, with testing and packaging.

tracks.name: Games & graphics
tracks.blurb: Game loops, rendering, performance, and media processing.

tracks.name: Scientific computing & research
tracks.blurb: Numerical methods, simulation, optimization and reproducible analysis.

tracks.name: Quantitative finance
tracks.blurb: Market data, backtesting without bias, risk and portfolio analysis.

tracks.name: Test automation & quality engineering
tracks.blurb: Test strategy from unit to end-to-end, on real services and pipelines.

tracks.name: Network automation
tracks.blurb: Linux, networking and Python tooling to configure and validate networks.

tracks.name: Embedded & IoT
tracks.blurb: Python on microcontrollers and single-board computers, connected to services.
